thesis: This run focused on strong entries in silver, gold, and copper mining. GR Silver Mining Ltd. and A2 Gold Corp. were initially considered for their strong composite scores driven by exceptional drilling results. However, due to recent auto-rebalance actions, these positions were not reopened this run. Giant Mining Corp. was successfully opened with a long position due to its exceptional copper grade of 73.4% and moderate drill program type. Great Pacific Gold Corp. also maintained a strong position with solid drilling results.
